title: Make unsupported model profiles explicit
description:
Review model profile defaults. Avoid mapping every profile, including embedding/economy/helper profiles, to the premium DM model by default.

Unsupported profiles should fail clearly unless intentionally configured.
acceptance_criteria:
- premium_dm remains configured for the intended premium model.
- unsupported or unimplemented profiles fail explicitly.
- helper/economy/embedding profiles do not silently route to premium_dm by accident.
- Tests cover profile resolution failure behavior.
close_reason: Implemented via discriminated union ProfileEntry = ConfiguredProfileEntry | UnconfiguredProfileEntry. Only premium_dm has a default; others throw on getProfile() access. Tests cover all failure cases. PR #69.
